_comment: The T Poker wall plaque — a separate module. Change the artwork, size or position here and re-run render.sh; nothing else in the scene depends on it. Artwork: the owner's official app icon and the wordmark cut from the official banner (see prep_brand.py). Proportions follow the banner: wordmark cap height ≈ 0.225 × icon height, gap ≈ 0.2 × icon height.
